purpose: Training and selection pilot. Outer features are not exported to any model worker.
training_data: all fit cycles; none removed using hidden RUL; all unlabeled for stage1; only 30 positives disclosed for stage2
source_loss_control: same initialization, 30 labels and batch RNG; e=norm(normalized residual direction) as released code
selection: stage1 epoch=min unaugmented early_stop MSE; stage2 epoch=max selection AP (first exact tie); detector=max selection AP (first exact tie); threshold=max selection F1 (highest threshold within 1e-12)
candidate_policy: every candidate attempted and recorded; invalid candidate makes pilot REVIEW_REQUIRED; none silently dropped
adaptations: 21 C-MAPSS sensor inputs; source hidden widths256/128, latent64, projection2 retained
source64 is an expansion of21, not a dimension-matched AE/PCA ablation
C-MAPSS augmentation: independent Gaussian noise std0.05 then zero-mask p0.05; no sensor permutation/cropping
fit-only input and SCLM-output standardization; output scaling only for classical detectors
all fit samples retained; no synthetic2percent contamination; 30 positives from30 fit engines
200/50 epochs per supplement;20 batches per epoch per released sampler; fresh resampling each epoch
separate early_stop and selection engines; no outer use; no source test-driven checkpoint choice
raw-error stage2 as Eq24 plus separately named unit-direction source-loss control
MSE pretrain convention follows released code; not Eq21 L2 norm; explicit contrastive coefficient direction
zero-residual numerical guard; CPU portability; separate stage-correct cosine horizons
released linear score is not a calibrated probability; no sigmoid or hidden activations added
